blocks.html: Where a building faces on three streets or public spaces, one Fire Department connection shall be provided for each 300 feet (91 140 mm) of building wall or fraction thereof facing upon such streets or public spaces provided that at least one Fire Department connection is installed on each of the parallel streets or public spaces, and further provided that the Fire Department connections shall be located so that the distance between them does not exceed 300 feet (91 140 mm).
